system.description: A frail wizard who gave up body, face and name piece by piece to become the skull-god of magic and secrets, knowing every answer but rarely sharing.
system.summary: A frail wizard who gave up body, face and name piece by piece to become the skull-god of magic and secrets, knowing every answer but rarely sharing.
commandments: Seek mental perfection by balancing reason, perception and emotion.
Gather, preserve and guard secret knowledge; found libraries and hunt ancient lore.
directives: Secrets carry fear and hope, and above all power.
Master the Warp and sorcery, braving its riskiest paths.
Whoever uncovers the unknown gains mastery over fate.
Existence after death lasts longer and offers more than life.
Immortality does more than prolong life; it makes the impossible possible.

cults.name: Confessionals
cults.summary: Temples that pay outsiders cash for secrets according to their worth and keep them perfectly; liars quietly vanish.

cults.name: Librarians
cults.summary: Guardians of true history who copy records into a hidden library whose location even they do not know.
